title: Blow-up convergence of the vector measure ν μ on C¹ vector test fields (3a)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, D, F ⊆ ℝ^{m+1} with F Borel, μ a measure and ν : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ^{m+1} satisfying (GG) ∫_F div φ dL^{m+1} = −∫ ⟨φ, ν⟩ dμ for every C¹ compactly supported φ with tsupport φ ⊆ D. Let y, v ∈ ℝ^{m+1} with |v| = 1 and ρ₁ > 0 with B̄_{ρ₁}(y) ⊆ D, and assume that for every R, L^{m+1}((F_{y,r} Δ {w : ⟨w, v⟩ > 0}) ∩ B_R(0)) → 0 as r ↓ 0, where F_{y,r} := {w : y + r w ∈ F}. Then for every C¹ compactly supported g : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ^{m+1}, r^{-m} ∫ ⟨g(r^{-1}(z − y)), ν(z)⟩ dμ(z) → ∫_{(span{v})^⊥} ⟨g, v⟩ dH^m as r ↓ 0 (H^m = μHE[m]).
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (D F : Set (Euclid (m + 1))) (μ : Measure (Euclid (m + 1))) (ν : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)) (y v : Euclid (m + 1)) (ρ₁ : ℝ), MeasurableSet F → (∀ φ : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∫ z in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ φ z : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) = -∫ z, inner ℝ (φ z) (ν z) ∂μ) → 0 < ρ₁ → closedBall y ρ₁ ⊆ D → ‖v‖ = 1 → (∀ R : ℝ, Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => volume (symmDiff ((fun w => y + r • w) ⁻¹' F) {w | 0 < inner ℝ w v} ∩ ball (0 : Euclid (m + 1)) R)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)) → ∀ g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (r ^ m)⁻¹ * ∫ z, inner ℝ (g (r⁻¹ • (z - y))) (ν z) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ z in ((Submodule.span ℝ {v})ᗮ : Set (Euclid (m + 1))), inner ℝ (g z) v ∂μHE[m]))
